verdict.rationale: Antigravity lets developers instruct agents in natural language ('natural language code commands', 'Edit, orchestrate, and build all in natural language'). Those agents can operate across the editor, terminal and browser, and can delegate test runs and codebase searches to subagents. These are the building blocks of natural-language troubleshooting, but no evidence explicitly describes debugging or diagnosing issues, so the capability is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of debugging/troubleshooting workflows (e.g., error diagnosis, stack-trace analysis, debugger integration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging via natural-language queries.
